_meta.description: shared-label-list (board PqBeheerMarketing, Labels card). One list of labels that articles, leads and clients pick from, so two colleagues no longer write 'Ondernemers' and 'ondernemer'. A label is a word in the list, not a link: an item stores the label's name. The forms offer the list through x-options-from on the items; hideWhenEmpty keeps a form from falling back to free text while the list is empty. Only an administrator writes the list: OpenRegister lets the admin group through before any rule, and the write verbs name nobody else. Renaming a label rewrites it on the items that carry it (LabelRenameService); deleting one leaves the text on its items. A fresh install starts with an empty list; the Zuiddrecht example set brings the five board labels. Sorts after 97-marketing-articles.json so the picker lands on article.tags. The slug is itemLabel, not label: OpenRegister slugs are global and planninq owns label.
